source: Derived from V0.3 macro placement; new coastline geometry. V0.1-V0.3 files remain unchanged.

method.geometry: One closed irregular SVG polygon per continent. Coastline modulation introduces distinct promontories, narrow peninsulas, deeper bays and asymmetric margins; Sunken Sands is rotated into a northwest-southeast diagonal. Vertices are simplified for readable vector geometry, then area-normalized.
method.area_measurement: Shoelace planar area in SVG canvas coordinates, using vertices rounded to 0.01 SVG units.
method.target_basis: Target shares are percentages of total land area, not planetary surface area.
limitations: No map projection or globe orientation is defined.
No geographic coordinates, coast-distance or plate-containment validation.
Illustrative grid is not a latitude/longitude grid.
The Veiled Continent's deep inward notch is a conceptual bay, not a validated inland sea/strait hydrology model.
